title: Tories criticised over claim Braverman defected to Reform after ‘mental health’ issues
summary: Statement, since withdrawn, followed ex-minister becoming third Conservative MP to join Farage’s party in just over a week The Conservatives are facing a backlash after claiming that Suella Braverman defected to Reform UK after “mental health” issues, as the former home secretary finally joined Nigel Farage’s party after months of denials. Braverman, who was sacked from the cabinet by both Liz Truss and Rishi Sunak, became the third sitting Conservative MP to defect in little over a week.
